messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] crashloop detected: Deployment=redwood-runtime v3.2.1, node=gpu-prod-3-12, container=runtime-engine, failures=43 in 5m, symptom=SIGSEGV. Paging @tom :rotating_light:

 tom: taking it. pinging eng-runtime and SRE. what's current customer impact?

 sara: seeing ~12% 503s from gateway for a handful of high-qps customers (acct ids: cust_42, cust_99). No full region outage but latency spikes for short requests.

 alex: sharing tail logs from runtime-engine on gpu-prod-3-12:
 ```
 [2026-03-17T09:12:03Z] E engine: TRT load failed: cudaErrorIllegalAddress (700)
 [2026-03-17T09:12:03Z] E engine: kernel_launch failed: illegal memory access
 [2026-03-17T09:12:03Z] F runtime-engine: Segmentation fault (core dumped)
 ```

 alex: also seeing `NVML: ECC errors` increments and `nvidia-smi` shows GPU memory still allocated after crash.

 maria: ok. immediate mitigation plan: 1) cordon node gpu-prod-3-12, 2) drain pods to other GPU pools, 3) collect core + nvcrash, 4) roll back runtime image to v3.2.0 (last-known-good) while eng-runtime debugs.

 maria: running: `kubectl cordon gpu-prod-3-12`
 maria: running: `kubectl drain gpu-prod-3-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`

 ops: note that draining will spike cold-start latency for in-flight sessions; gateway fallback should absorb some load but expect short lived errors.

 alex: collecting core and diagnostics: `gcore $(pidof runtime-engine) || true` and `tar -cvzf /mnt/telemetry/5976543210/cores.tar.gz /var/crash/* /var/log/runtime/*.log /var/log/nvidia/*`
 alex: uploading to S3 at s3://redwood-telemetry/5976543210/ (privileged link).

 tom: assigning to eng-runtime (ping @eng-runtime). Temporary policy: set rollout to previous image tag v3.2.0 for deployment/redwood-runtime in prod to avoid new TRT fused-kernel path.

 lee: oncall-2 here, I can take over in ~10m. will watch for new segfaults and monitor rollback progress.

 incident-bot: Routing policy applied: affected customer traffic for cust_42, cust_99 routed to quantized-fallback model variant until rollback completes. Error rate for those customers dropped to ~2%.

 customer-success: notified 10 impacted customers with an interim note: we detected instability on an engine variant, we've routed traffic to a fallback model, and expect restoration in ~30m.

 alex: preliminary hypothesis: v3.2.1 introduced a fused custom kernel path in TRT that triggers illegal memory access on specific driver/hardware combinations (NVIDIA 5300-series drivers). Repro under triage VMs in progress.

 maria: initiating rollback: `kubectl set image deployment/redwood-runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:v3.2.0 --record`
 maria: rollback started — k8s is spinning up v3.2.0 pods in other GPU pools, terminating the v3.2.1 pods as they are evicted.

 incident-bot: Rollout status: 20 pods updated, 5 pods pending image pull, 2 pods failing healthcheck (investigating).

 tom: monitoring: 503s trending down to baseline, overall latency tail still elevated but stabilizing. Leaving handoff notes for next oncall.

 lee: acknowledged. I will monitor logs, confirm core uploads, and coordinate with eng-runtime for a root-cause ticket. Assigned INF-7891 to eng-runtime.

 tom: handing off to @lee (oncall-2). last checks: rollback in progress, customer fallback in place, core + nvcrash uploaded. If anything spikes, ping me. :thumbsup:
